name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence(at_exit) clause captures the requirement to reach the exit. The hard Response(box_fell, holding_box) clause correctly captures the conditional requirement 'whenever the box falls, pick it up again', meaning every time `box_fell` occurs, `holding_box` must become true subsequently (captured by a pickup action). Both clauses are grounded in the task text and the environment propositions. The machine topology reflects these constraints correctly.

texts: Whenever the box falls, pick it up again (hold the box) afterwards.
machine:

INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0

(u0, at_exit&box_fell&holding_box) -> u2

(u1, at_exit&!holding_box) -> u3
(u1, at_exit&holding_box) -> u2
